title: Novel cuproptosis-related long non-coding RNA signature to predict prognosis in prostate carcinoma.
summary: RNA-seq/clinical data from 553 TCGA samples are divided into training/validation cohorts; survival and ROC analyses are reported, without an external validation dataset.
ai_technology: LASSO and stepwise Cox models construct a cuproptosis-related lncRNA signature for prostate-cancer disease-free survival.
organization: Department of Urology; Jiangxi Institute of Urology

evidence.tested: RNA-seq/clinical data from 553 TCGA samples are divided into training/validation cohorts; survival and ROC analyses are reported, without an external validation dataset.
evidence.unknown: This is a retrospective prognostic association with no experimental mechanism validation; interpret as a cohort-specific signature.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO and stepwise Cox models construct a cuproptosis-related lncRNA signature for prostate-cancer disease-free survival.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
